scope: Actual diagnostic UI with virtual authenticator and fictional data;no real credential/provider/physical device/security proof

checks.name: Probe loads without automatically creating a credential or storing a record
Explicit confirmation/create flow recognizes virtual PRF and distinguishes enrollment from saved data
Actual probe encrypts in IndexedDB, reloads and decrypts through virtual passkey while network-disabled
Visible Cancel stops a pending ceremony, retains ciphertext and permits an explicit successful retry
Local-data removal accurately preserves the provider credential and has keyboard/Escape/confirmation semantics
Non-PRF passkey produces an explicit unsupported result without an unencrypted data fallback
Eight EN/AR phone/tablet/desktop layouts fit without horizontal page overflow
No app console/page errors or external page requests in the isolated diagnostic

limitations: Physical Touch ID/provider PRF not tested
Repeated failed-verification recovery remains a separate unresolved research case
No cold hosted offline boot or process-restart physical-key proof
